extracted.name: Father’s Day Chocolate Cake
extracted.description: A rich and moist chocolate cake made with simple ingredients, perfect for celebrating Father’s Day! #CookpadApron2026
instruction_lines: In a large bowl, combine the flour, sugar, cocoa powder, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
Add the eggs, milk, vegetable oil, vanilla extract, and hot water. Mix until the batter is smooth.
Bake for 30–35 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Melt the chocolate in the microwave and
Pour it over the cake as a simple chocolate sauce. And enjoy❤️
